chhath mahima | chhath puja ke paranprik bhojpuri git | Chhath Mahima Jukebox
Chhathi maiya ki mahima aur sury dev ki upasna ko samarpit is bhaktimay chhath git sangrah ke sath chhath puja ke pavan parv ka aanand len. prastut hai chhathi maiya ki aaradhna, sury dev ko arghy dene ki paranpra aur chhath vrat ki mahima ka gungan karne vale madhur bhojpuri chhath giton ka vishesh sangraha.
Is Chhath Mahima Jukebox men anuradha paudval (Anuradha Paudwal) aur ajit kumar akela (Ajeet Kumar Akela) ke bhaktimay git sunen aur chhathi maiya evan sury dev ka aashirvad prapt karen.
jay chhathi maiya!
